entities.name: Islamic Reform & Revival Movements
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A spectrum of movements seeking to revitalize and reform Islam in response to modernization and Western colonialism. From Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's revivalism to Muhammad Abduh's modernism and the Deobandi movement, these reformers debated how Islam should engage with modernity, producing both conservative and progressive responses that continue to shape the Muslim world.
